sources.title: ClinVar variant records (GRCh38)
sources.note: Local variant_summary.txt; snapshot date is not recorded. Downloads retain all source columns for GRCh38 records matched by NCBI Gene ID. These records may differ from the dated gene-summary totals. No variant-level dominant inheritance assignment is supplied.

sources.title: Targeting SNP records
sources.note: GRCh38 common SNP candidates, cell-line genotype evidence and selection flags. Each row is a variant/editor/window association. Recovered source coverage is incomplete.

sources.title: gRNA sequences and target associations
sources.note: NGG-compatible guides on GRCh38 plus the focal allele; neighboring variants are unphased. Guide/editor/window associations can repeat a guide. Selection and provisional editing-window flags are preserved.

sources.title: Expanded indel and splice screen
sources.note: D&D, ClinGen HI and two additional control genes. Results are separate from the D&D reference workbook; CRISPRoff and excision were not run.

sources.title: Expanded-screen SNP records
sources.note: Common SNPs in shared exonic and splice regions. Splice distances are 1-23 bp and 1-30 bp; AF is 0.1-0.9. These are candidate counts before cell-line expression and genotype selection.

sources.title: Expanded-screen gRNA records
sources.note: NGG guides with source sequence, geometry, NMD and selection flags. The primary screen uses the 10 bp SNP-to-PAM rule; broader guide records retain their filter flags.

sources.title: Expanded-screen transcript models
sources.note: Defines assessed genes and chromosomes; absence from variant records alone is never used to infer a tested zero.

sources.title: Expanded-screen NMD results
sources.note: Predictions consistent across retained transcripts. Mixed predictions need not be classified as inducing or escaping NMD.

sources.title: Expanded-screen NMD variant positions
sources.note: Positions with consistent NMD induction or escape across retained transcripts.

sources.title: Expanded-screen NMD exclusions
sources.note: NMD cannot be evaluated when a retained transcript lacks coding coordinates.

sources.title: Ensembl gene coordinates
sources.note: GRCh38 coordinates for SPTLC1, checked against the Ensembl gene ID. Other genes use ClinGen coordinates where supplied, or a UCSC canonical-gene search.
